reviews.title: Stuck
reviews.text: Stuck on the photo loading page. Never works. Really frustrating!

reviews.title: Not working with edited photos
reviews.text: I reported a bug. The support person gave some generic troubleshooting steps, then later said an update is coming this week that should resolve the issue, and it did not… Now they’re saying they’ll go ahead and report the issue to the IT team but they need my account information. I don’t have an account I continued as guest… They’re confused because they think you can’t use the app as a guest. 🤦 These folks don’t understand their own app it’s so frustrating. As of now the issue is not resolved and they stopped replying…

reviews.title: Defective book difficult to obtain replacement
reviews.text: I received a damaged book and was offered 15% off purchase price or 30% off further order. When I questioned this and asked for a replacement I was told that this was a shipping issue and that they are trying to reduce carbon footprint. They then did offer me a ‘free book’. I found this response upsetting as if they were putting blame on me. I do care for the environment but I also wanted an undamaged book of memories.  I am very time poor as a busy mum so sending multiple emails to obtain a replacement was difficult for me. I will not order from this company again.

reviews.title: Crashing
reviews.text: I want to love this app but I can’t even begin making my album without it crashing and losing all my progress without saving - I’m about to use a different service at this point!

reviews.title: Unresponsive
reviews.text: Ordered and no action on it for 3 business days, nor a reply by email when reaching out. Disappointing for the cos

reviews.title: No landscape view
reviews.text: Found this very well designed except it does not support a landscape view on my tablet, making layout design frustrating.
Doesn’t work with google photos even though it gives you the option to do so. I’ve spent 2 hours trying to get it to work. Very frustrating
